verdict.rationale: Anytype has no native automation engine, but it offers building blocks for one. The CLI can run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, there is a local API, and external agents can run scripts against Anytype data for bulk edits and repetitive tasks. Autonomous background automations therefore depend on user-built scripts or third-party agent tools rather than a built-in feature. Missing for 10: native in-app automation rules/triggers, scheduling or background job execution, documentation of autonomous unattended workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
